en.name: RRB Station Master
specs: Photo: NO upload — it is captured LIVE by webcam or the phone's front camera during the form. Plain white background, dark-coloured clothes, no cap, mask or spectacles, and your head should cover at least half the frame.
Signature: JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, minimum 140 x 60 pixels, black ink, running handwriting (no block capitals), scanned at 100 DPI or more.
SC/ST candidates claiming the free travel pass: caste certificate as a PDF under 400 KB.
